name: Foradada (Spain)
description: Purple field with the middle vertical third yellow, charged with a black cross patty above and a purple square below.
history: The official flag of Foradada is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, purple, with the second vertical third yellow, charged above, at the centre and at 1/4 from the upper edge, with a black Greek cross patty of height 1/6 of the cloth, and below with a purple square; approved by the municipal council on 8 February 2002 and published in the DOGC on 1 August 2002.

features.role: cross patty in the upper part of the yellow third
square in the lower part of the yellow third
